text: The Building Resilience to Climate Change in Papua New Guinea (BRCC) project is a comprehensive initiative aimed at integrating climate risk management into subnational development planning, piloting community-level adaptation, and establishing a framework for climate-resilient infrastructure. It focuses on vulnerable atoll and island communities across five provinces, addressing climate change impacts through assessments, planning, and infrastructure development.
